Title: Generally available: Azure Batch supports Spot Virtual Machines

Body.Content:
Azure Batch offers Spot Virtual Machines in user-subscription Batch accounts. The Spot Virtual Machines are available as single-instance virtual machines (VMs) or Virtual Machine Scale Sets. Take advantage of Spot Virtual Machine's surplus capacity available in Azure. In addition, you get unique Azure pricing and benefits when running Windows Server workloads on Spot Virtual Machine's.

Learn more about Spot Virtual Machine's here.
